items.name: Scalpel
items.text: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Overseer's Robes
items.text: Adventurers who don't wear armor travel in durable clothing. Though it's not armor and uses your unarmored defense proficiency, it still has a Dex Cap and can grant an item bonus to AC if etched with potency runes.

items.name: Carbauxine Backlash
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect When Naptha takes fire damage, the carbauxine gas leaking from her ignites, dealing 10 fire damage to all other creatures in a 10-foot emanation.

items.name: Emotional Control
items.text:
Trigger Naptha fails or critically fails a saving throw against an emotion effect

---
Effect Naptha clamps down her emotions. She rerolls the saving throw, using the second result. She is then Slowed 1 on her next turn.

items.name: Bloodletting
items.text:
Requirements Naptha's last action was a melee scalpel Strike that did precision damage

---
Effect Naptha attempts a Medicine check check against the target's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical success) or increases its drained condition value by 1 (or by 2 on a critical success), to a maximum of Drained 4.

items.name: Carbauxine Breath
items.text: Naptha exhales a gout of carbauxine gas and ignites it, creating a blast that deals 15d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone or 60-foot line (DC 34 basic Reflex save save). Naptha can't use Carbauxine Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Surgical Precision
items.text: Naptha attempts a Medicine check check against the Fortitude DC of one living creature she can see within 30 feet. On a success, until the end of her turn Naptha's scalpel Strikes deal an extra 8d4 precision damage against that creature; on a critical success, her scalpel Strikes against the creature also deal 4d4 persistent bleed damage. On a critical failure, the creature gains temporary immunity to Surgical Precision for 1 day.

items.name: Suture Wounds
items.text:
Requirements Naptha is holding or wearing a Healer's Toolkit

---
Effect Naptha knits her own wounds or the wounds of an adjacent creature. She attempts a Medicine check check with the same DC as Treat Wounds (up to DC 30) and restores the corresponding amount of HP. The target is then immune to Suture Wounds until it takes more damage.
